product_launches.description: Secure.com launched Digital Security Teammate, an AI-native agent that integrates with existing security stacks to automate alert triage, incident response, and compliance tasks for lean security teams.

overview_description.description: Secure.com provides governed AI security Teammates that take on real security work across SOC, GRC, Cloud Security, AppSec, and Red Team functions. Each Teammate operates inside the scope, permissions, and approvals its team defines, so consequential action stays in human hands. Offense finds what's exploitable; defense hardens it, resolves it, and proves the outcome. Teams start with one Teammate and expand coverage as needs mature. The Teammates sit above the stack you already own and deploy in days, handing security teams back hundreds of hours and cutting the grunt work that drives burnout.

product.name: Secure.com Digital Security Teammates
product.description: An AI-powered cybersecurity platform that automates security triage, investigation, response, asset visibility, risk prioritization, and compliance workflows across connected tools.

product.name: Essential Security Teammate
product.description: A foundational Secure.com security operations offering providing asset visibility, alert triage, and baseline security automation without requiring additional tools or headcount.

product.name: Advanced Security Teammate
product.description: An expanded security operations offering that adds automated investigations, multi-cloud visibility, and customizable workflows to the capabilities of Essential Security Teammate.

product.name: Asset Intelligence
product.description: An asset visibility and prioritization solution that discovers assets agentlessly, maps relationships and business context, and supports lifecycle and risk-management workflows.

product.name: Security Programs
product.description: Modular security programs that combine Secure.com automation and workflows for specific security, risk, visibility, and compliance objectives.

product.name: White-Glove Onboarding and 24/7 Support
product.description: Implementation and support services that help customers connect their security tools, configure workflows, and operate Secure.com continuously.
